name: bandit.scout_to_decision_observer_live_mcw
description: Observer-backed vertical probe from an idle zero-lead bandit camp at (164,39,0), with the player at (162,36,0), two OMTs west and one OMT south of the sector-0 inner waypoint at (164,35,0), a fixture-installed clear road sightline at (163,32,0), its concealed forest watch at (163,33,0), and the sector-0 outer target at (164,30,0) on the existing continuous x=164 north-south road. Production discovers local leads and reaches its stable-ID-derived 13-hour frontier deadline, then dispatches and hands off the sector-0 pair through the real route. A selected-entity capture-and-continue watch follows an initial six-hour natural window before authoritative survivor-return, final-report, and camp-decision audit.

proof_gates.label: Authoritative bandit report consumed into claimed follow-on

evidence_contract.claim: from an idle zero-lead camp on the continuous x=164 road, production naturally discovers terrain, reaches its ID-derived frontier deadline, dispatches and physically hands off an exact pair, exposes that authoritative pair to the shared observer, records one natural incident, returns at least one scout carrier home, and lets the next hourly scheduler claim one hostile follow-on from that exact final report
evidence_contract.preconditions_and_interventions: the source fixture establishes only the idle five-member camp at (164,39,0), zero evidence, the road-connected sector-0 outer target (164,30,0), and deterministic clock; the southwest derived fixture preserves DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE, adds DEBUG_NODMG only as an observer-only incidental-wildlife survival control, moves the player observer from (162,35,0) to (162,36,0), two OMTs west and one OMT south of the same route waypoint at (164,35,0), installs one setup-only road terrain at (163,32,0) so the existing concealed forest watch at (163,33,0) has a clear bounded sightline, and binds the authoritative player-view persistence with typed player_view_seen_omt(abs_omt=[163,33,0], [162,36,0], [161,37,0], [160,38,0], [160,39,0], vision_level=full) for the retained ordinary route corridor and selected-watch destination; every view binding and the observer-only survival control are setup-only and grant no gameplay credit; the scenario performs no ecology edit
evidence_contract.causal_boundary: fixture installation ends before terrain discovery, dispatch, local handoff, observation, assessment, egress, return, report, or decision
evidence_contract.fixture_feasibility_gate: Before this row can receive causal credit, the production selector must emit bandit_live_world watch_geography_preflight for the installed fixture; its bounded-candidate predicate counts, rather than the continuous-road assertion, decide whether a natural watch footing exists.
evidence_contract.real_code_path: hourly structural terrain scan and scheduler -> exact-pair dispatch -> route/local handoff and cohesion -> production observation and assessment -> return ownership -> report delivery and camp decision acceptance -> next hourly authorization, hostile-operation reservation, and global target claim
evidence_contract.expected_transition: idle/no-lead -> natural terrain memory -> due frontier lead -> exact local pair -> meaningful selected-entity delta -> at-least-one-survivor physical return -> final report -> report-awaiting-assessment decision -> preparing-follow-on -> one claimed shakedown reservation
evidence_contract.negative_control: preflight requires zero leads and zero outing; the incident must report natural provenance, debug_intervention=false, and an empty intervention ledger
evidence_contract.timeout: two six-hour waits plus one one-hour wait reach the ID-derived frontier deadline, followed by the next three hourly structural advances and one initial six-hour post-observation window; no completion state may be injected
evidence_contract.pass_fail_rule: The row is green only when preflight, exact production dispatch/handoff, observer selection/watch, natural incident pair, at least one same-run scout survivor home, the next hourly response-operation application, save writeback, closed scout outing, final non-provisional report, report-to-decision identity match, and report-to-hostile-claim identity match are all green. Return is owned by the post-window live-log audit and final saved-state audit, not by the bounded wait-menu completion token, so an intermediate no-progress incident remains capturable.
evidence_contract.observer_artifact_requirement: Coordinator inspection must find one post-window ecology_incident JSON/PNG pair for the selected canonical ID with natural provenance, debug_intervention=false, and an empty intervention ledger.
evidence_contract.identity_requirement: The run artifact must retain commit, binary, fixture, scenario, selected canonical ID, and observer-tool identities.
